name: A Bone to Pick
source:
A small comedy visual novel where you the player have a chance to date Sans Undertale! But you have a chance to create your own story with him! Be careful in your choices or chaos and other untold horrors could ensue.

[From [url=https://jaiku0n.itch.io/a-bone-to-pick]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部小型喜剧视觉小说，让你有机会与《传说之下》中的Sans约会！你还能与他共同创造属于自己的故事！不过，选择可要小心，否则混乱与其他不可言说的恐怖，就可能接踵而来。

[摘自[url=https://jaiku0n.itch.io/a-bone-to-pick]itch.io[/url]]
